LanguageData.VRE_AuburnSkin.description: Carriers of this gene have muddy dark red-brown skin.
LanguageData.VRE_AuburnSkin.label: auburn Skin
LanguageData.VRE_Brave.description: Carriers of this gene are much more resilient to stress and exhibit behaviors typically classified as brave.
LanguageData.VRE_Brave.label: brave
LanguageData.VRE_ChocolateSkin.description: Carriers of this gene have muddy light brown skin.
LanguageData.VRE_ChocolateSkin.label: chocolate Skin
LanguageData.VRE_Coward.description: Carriers of this gene are much more prone to repond to nervous situations by cowering, hiding, or even going catatonic.
LanguageData.VRE_Coward.label: coward
LanguageData.VRE_CurledTail.description: Carriers of this gene grow a short, curly tail that does not serve any purpose.
LanguageData.VRE_CurledTail.label: curled tail
LanguageData.VRE_EverGrowing.description: Carriers of this gene do not stop growing until they reach a biological age of 60. They will keep increasing in size, reaching gargantuan sizes.\n\nAs they grow, they will become slower, but also stagger-immune. With size, their health pool will also increase.
LanguageData.VRE_EverGrowing.label: ever growing
LanguageData.VRE_ExtraMeat.description: Carriers of this gene have much more dense meat and fat tissue, resulting in greater meat yield when butchered.
LanguageData.VRE_ExtraMeat.label: extra meat
LanguageData.VRE_FastAging.description: Carriers of this gene have an artificial mutation in their genetic material, causing them to age twice as fast as a standard baseliner.
LanguageData.VRE_FastAging.label: fast aging
LanguageData.VRE_Gluttonous.description: Carriers of this gene have elastic, bottomless stomachs and are capable of consuming twice as much food.\n\nThey will become increasingly unhappy if hungry, and most mental breaks will be food binges.
LanguageData.VRE_Gluttonous.label: Gluttonous
LanguageData.VRE_HazelnutSkin.description: Carriers of this gene have light tan hazelnut-like skin.
LanguageData.VRE_HazelnutSkin.label: hazelnut Skin
LanguageData.VRE_LowMeat.description: Carriers of this gene have very thin meat and fat tissue, resulting in much smaller meat yield when butchered.
LanguageData.VRE_LowMeat.label: low meat
LanguageData.VRE_MouthTusks.description: Carriers of this gene grow two small tusks protruding from the jaw.
LanguageData.VRE_MouthTusks.label: mouth tusks
LanguageData.VRE_OrganRegeneration.description: Carriers of this gene have improved regenerating factors in their DNA, allowing them to slowly regenerate organs that may even be completely missing. The process is slow, and will prioritize healing existing, but damaged, organs.
LanguageData.VRE_OrganRegeneration.label: organ regeneration
LanguageData.VRE_PigSkin.description: Carriers of this gene will yield pigskin when butchered. Wearing pigskin clothing by them is classed as wearing human leather clothing.
LanguageData.VRE_PigSkin.label: pigskin
LanguageData.VRE_PorkFlesh.description: Carriers of this gene have traces of pork in their flesh. Consuming pork by them is classed as cannibalism. When butchered, they will yield pork instead of human meat.
LanguageData.VRE_PorkFlesh.label: pork flesh
LanguageData.VRE_RapidAging.description: Carriers of this gene have an artificial mutation in their genetic material, causing them to age four times as fast as a standard baseliner.
LanguageData.VRE_RapidAging.label: rapid aging
LanguageData.VRE_SlowAging.description: Carriers of this gene have an artificial mutation in their genetic material, causing them to age much slower than a standard baseliner.
LanguageData.VRE_SlowAging.label: slow aging
